description: This file defines animation functions for pane transitions in a web application, specifically animating entrance and exit of panes with support for Safari browser fix.

methods.name: animatePaneEntranceTransitionFromOffscreenToTheRight
methods.description: Animates a pane element from offscreen right into view and triggers a Safari-specific layout fix.

methods.name: animatePaneExitTransitionOffscreenToTheRight
methods.description: Animates a pane element from its current position off to the right and awaits completion.
